mask_definition: thumb-owned vertices inside the THUMB|INDEX ownership-boundary band (2 mesh median edges) whose thumb-chain arc is proximal of the thumb IP joint minus one transition band and whose index-chain arc is proximal of the index PIP joint plus one transition band; nail and distal-cap vertices excluded

R1_mask_was.rule: distance to BOTH chains <= 2 x median edge, no arc bound
R1_mask_was.conclusion: the R1 'first web' mask did NOT capture the thumb-index web: it captured the thumb DISTAL PHALANX / tip contact zone, because in this pose the thumb tip abuts the index MCP region.  THUMB_IP in that mask is therefore CORRECT, not leakage.

geometric_evidence.statement: the only thumb-index surface interface in this pose lies at the thumb's DISTAL phalanx (3.28 mm); at the thumb MCP the digits are 18.11 mm apart, so no surface vertex can be inside BOTH digit tubes proximal of the thumb IP joint.  The first web is therefore defined as the thumb-index ownership-boundary band restricted to the anatomical window, not by proximity of the two chains.
